intent.outcome: Execute and chrome can be tested and extended without mutate-during-paint and without dropping async runtime handles at navigation boundaries. Render is effectively a pure draw of prepared state; App owns long-lived execute runtime.

problem.description: ui::render takes &mut App and components mutate viewport/scroll during paint; Confirm discards AsyncExecutor so abort cannot be owned for Execute lifetime. That caused false-green tests and dead cancel paths. M04 landed toast on AppContext; deeper seams remain. Predictable fix: pure-ish paint for execute/chrome path + App-owned execute runtime before dep cleanup and native engine touch the same files.

in_scope: prepare/layout vs paint for the main ui::render path and ExecuteComponent at minimum (viewport/scroll bookkeeping not only inside paint)
Other screens: batch cheap prepare if touched; full conversion of every screen is nice-to-have, not a gate
Keep Component stack; adjust trait only as needed for snapshot paint
App owns AsyncExecutor or AbortHandle while Execute is on the stack; Confirm must not drop the only handle
App::update_components drains ExecutionUpdate into active ExecuteComponent; toast tick remains on App update
Add at least one automated assertion that execute progress advances via App-owned drain (tui_e2e and/or a focused test)
AGENTS principles already present — S4 only tweaks if code diverges; gitignore already set
out_of_scope: ratatui major version bump (M06 S6 only, after this milestone)
Full AppEvent enum for every future feature
Rewriting screen body UIs or toast product (M04 done)
Converting every Component to pure &self paint in one PR if Execute + ui::render are fixed

findings.description: The prepare seam is introduced and wired into ui::render, but only Execute and Confirm migrate viewport bookkeeping out of paint. help, status, package_select, and group_select still assign self.viewport_height inside render(). Explicitly within M05 scope (full conversion is nice-to-have, not a gate; out-of-scope: converting every Component in one PR), but recorded so the seam is not left half-finished. Follow-up for a later milestone.

AC-01 'no Execute viewport mutation during paint' is guaranteed only by code inspection, not by an automated test. render.rs stays green even if a future refactor moves the viewport_height assignment back into ExecuteComponent::render (L1: green tests do not imply correct behavior). Add a regression test asserting prepare owns viewport_height and render does not reassign it.

CHANGELOG.md Unreleased has no M05 entry. AGENTS.md requires each feature/change on wip to add an Unreleased changelog note; prepare/paint seam + App-owned AsyncExecutor are user-visible architecture changes. Add a Changed bullet under Unreleased.

findings.description: AsyncExecutor hand-off uses AppContext.pending_executor side-channel: (1) couples every AppContext fixture to execute runtime, (2) process_transition takes pending then immediately drops it when top!=Execute (silent abort-handle loss if staging is wrong), (3) Confirm mutates ctx as a second return path beside Transition. Carry the executor on Transition::Replace (Option<AsyncExecutor>) and remove pending_executor from AppContext.
findings.author: external-agent

findings.description: App::process_transition comments claim releasing executor closes the spawned task sender so the channel shuts down. False: AsyncExecutor::spawn keeps tx_clone inside the task; dropping App.executor only drops an extra Sender + AbortHandle (abort capability). Rewrite comments to describe abort ownership, not channel liveness.
